# Maya Salcedo

Maya Salcedo is a PhD student in the Institute of Bioinformatics at the University of Georgia and a member of The Fox Lab. Research in the lab includes Bayesian infectious disease forecasting.

::: {.profile-links}
[Email](mailto:Mariah.Salcedo@uga.edu)

## Research And Lab Highlights

### Bayesian forecasting

Maya presented a flexible framework for forecasting seasonal infectious disease dynamics while accounting for spatial correlations at the College of Public Health Research Day.

[Read the lab update](../../news/index.qmd#maya-presents-at-cph-research-day)

### Public health collaboration

Maya joined lab colleagues and CDC collaborators to discuss international respiratory virus forecasts using FluNet data.

[Read the lab update](../../news/index.qmd#cdc-on-site-forecasting-meeting)
